import json,sys

    print('ERROR:', d.get('error'), d.get('response_metadata',{}).get('messages'))
    sys.exit(1)
for c in d['channels']:
    topic = c.get('topic',{}).get('value','')
    if 'launch' in c.get('name','').lower() or 'cutover' in topic.lower() or 'go-live' in topic.lower() or 'go live' in topic.lower():

print('---ALL CHANNELS---')
for c in d['channels']:
    print(c['id'], '|', c['name'], '| topic:', repr(c.get('topic',{}).get('value','')))
"
